blocks.content: Soil formation begins with physical and chemical weathering of rocks. Over time, biological processes add organic matter and chemical processes rearrange minerals, forming distinct layers called horizons.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Soil formation (pedogenesis) starts with physical and chemical weathering of rocks.
Biological and chemical processes contribute organic matter and rearrange minerals to form distinct soil horizons.
The four main processes of pedogenesis are additions, losses, translocations, and transformations.
Leaching of nutrients and erosion represent the loss processes in soil profile development.
